samples.scenario: Prediction target period: from 2023-10-29 to 2024-01-14. Recent related events (events are separated by numbered tags): <1> Multiple outlets published retrospective reviews of the second weekend of the Austin City Limits (ACL) Music Festival, which took place from Friday, October 13 to Sunday, October 15, 2023. The recaps highlighted the unique atmosphere of the weekend, noting the hot, sunny weather on Friday and a cooler, breezy Saturday that was described as a "perfect festival day." A solar eclipse on Saturday morning was another memorable feature of the weekend experience. The reviews provided qualitative analysis of numerous performances. Artists like Maggie Rogers, The 1975, Jessie Ware, and Coi Leray received strong positive feedback, with descriptions of Rogers "hitting every single note perfectly" and Jessie Ware's "funky, pop sound" and "palpable" joy. Kendrick Lamar's headlining set drew mixed reactions; one reviewer found it underwhelming, while another praised the 21-song performance. Similarly, one account described the 30 Seconds to Mars show as "artificial," while another lauded its pyrotechnics and audience participation as making Saturday the "best day at ACL 2023." Other highlighted performers included The Altons, Ethel Cain, The Lumineers, and Lil Yachty, who was noted for proving his talent extends beyond rapping. The reports also mentioned logistical details, such as GloRilla taking the stage 35 minutes late and the high price of food, including a nearly $13 hotdog. <2> The lineup was officially announced on September 7, 2023. <3> The 2023 Electric Zoo electronic music festival, held on Randall's Island, experienced significant disruptions. The event's first day, scheduled for September 1, 2023, was cancelled just hours before its start time due to what organizers, Avant Gardner, cited as 'supply chain disruptions' preventing the completion of the main stage. The festival's troubles continued through the weekend, culminating on the final day, September 3, 2023, when organizers announced that the venue had reached capacity prematurely, denying entry to thousands of valid ticketholders. This led to chaotic scenes, including some attendees rushing the security gates. The NYPD later estimated that the final day was oversold by approximately 7,000 tickets. In the aftermath, multiple class-action lawsuits were filed against Avant Gardner, alleging false advertising, breach of contract, and dangerous overcrowding. <4> The 2023 Made in America festival, an annual Labor Day weekend event in Philadelphia founded by Jay-Z, was canceled. The cancellation was announced on August 8, 2023, due to 'severe circumstances outside of production control,' with no further elaboration provided by the organizers. The festival was scheduled to take place September 2-3 on the Benjamin Franklin Parkway and was set to be headlined by SZA and Lizzo. Other scheduled performers included Miguel, Ice Spice, and Metro Boomin. While organizers did not give a specific reason, the announcement came shortly after a lawsuit was filed against headliner Lizzo alleging sexual harassment and the creation of a hostile work environment. All ticket holders were to be refunded. Organizers stated they looked forward to returning in 2024. <5> The 2023 Newport Folk Festival was held at Fort Adams State Park in Newport, Rhode Island, from Friday, July 28, to Sunday, July 30, 2023. The diverse lineup featured headliners such as My Morning Jacket on Friday, Jon Batiste & Friends on Saturday, and Billy Strings on Sunday. While the festival is known for its surprise guests, the 2023 edition's most notable surprise was a last-minute change on Friday, July 28. James Taylor made an impromptu appearance, filling in for Noah Kahan, who had to cancel his performance due to vocal strain. Taylor, who was summering nearby, arrived by boat with about an hour's notice and performed a set that included classics like "Sweet Baby James" and "Fire and Rain." The festival also featured numerous planned collaborations, including My Morning Jacket being joined by guests Maggie Rogers and John Oates. <6> The Imagine Music Festival, an immersive four-day electronic music event, took place at Kingston Downs in Georgia from September 14-17, 2023. [2, 5] The festival featured a lineup of over 100 artists across four stages. [3, 6, 9] Headliners included Slander, Rezz, and Chris Lake. [6] A significant highlight of the event was the first-ever back-to-back festival performance by Subtronics and Ganja White Night, which was announced as part of the phase two lineup. [3] The extensive lineup also featured artists such as Big Gigantic, Dom Dolla, John Summit, and a back-to-back set from NGHTMRE and Diesel (Shaquille O'Neal). [6, 7] <7> The Life Is Beautiful festival celebrated its 10th anniversary over three days in downtown Las Vegas from September 22-24, 2023. The multi-genre event's headliners were The Killers, Kendrick Lamar, and Odesza. [2, 4, 7, 8] The broader lineup featured a variety of artists, including The 1975, Khalid, and the Yeah Yeah Yeahs. [5, 9] Beyond music, the festival also presented art installations and special performances by Las Vegas staples such as Cirque du Soleil, Blue Man Group, Meow Wolf, and Jabbawockeez. [10, 11] <8> Summerfest, known as 'The World's Largest Music Festival', held its 55th edition in 2023 at the Henry Maier Festival Park in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The event was scheduled over three consecutive weekends: June 22-24, June 29-July 1, and July 6-8. The festival showcased a diverse lineup of over 100 artists from various genres across its numerous stages. Performers for the first weekend included Eric Church, Elle King, the Zac Brown Band, Marcus King, James Taylor, and Sheryl Crow. Subsequent weekends featured acts such as the Dave Matthews Band, Odesza, Jimmy Buffett, and Imagine Dragons.

[8, 11] The 2024 festival lineup was officially revealed on February 29, 2024, through a special broadcast by Insomniac Events. [9, 11] For 2023, the event took place from May 19-21, drew over 525,000 attendees, and celebrated the 30th anniversary of the festival's promoter, Insomniac. [3, 5] <10> Movement, one of the world's longest-running electronic music festivals, The full lineup, which was announced on February 28, 2024, featured over 115 acts across six stages. This year's headliners included electronic music innovator Richie Hawtin, superstar DJ Solomun, and the previously announced Fatboy Slim. The extensive lineup also includes acts like Franc Moody, Sammy Virji, Molly Tuttle, Pigeons Playing Ping Pong, and the collaborative project LSZEE. The festival is known for its immersive art installations, particularly around Spirit Lake, and will see the return of the underground dance music stage, OFF LIMITS. <2> The 17th edition of the Outside Lands Music and Arts Festival, held in San Francisco's Golden Gate Park, announced its 2025 lineup on March 25, 2025. The festival is scheduled to take place from August 8-10, 2025. The lineup features over 110 acts, with headliners including Tyler, The Creator, Doja Cat, Hozier, and Doechii. Other prominent performers announced include Anderson .Paak & the Free Nationals, Vampire Weekend, John Summit, and Glass Animals. For Tyler, The Creator, this marks a return after cancelling his performance in 2024. <3> Lollapalooza is a four-day music festival held annually in Grant Park, Chicago. The 2025 festival will take place from Thursday, July 31, to Sunday, August 3, 2025. The lineup, featuring over 170 artists on eight stages, was announced in March 2025. The headliners for 2025 include Olivia Rodrigo, Tyler, The Creator, Luke Combs, Sabrina Carpenter, RÜFÜS DU SOL, A$AP Rocky, Korn, and the K-pop group TWICE. This marks several milestones: Luke Combs will be the festival's first-ever country music closing act, and TWICE will be the first female K-pop group to headline. Other notable performers on the extensive lineup include Gracie Abrams, Cage The Elephant, Doechii, Clairo, Bleachers, T-Pain, Dominic Fike, and Finneas. The Killers, Blink-182, SZA, and Future were performers at the 2024 festival, not the 2025 event. <4> The annual SXSW Conference & Festivals is a major event for the creative industries, held in Austin, Texas. The 2025 edition took place from March 7-15, 2025. Following the conclusion of the 2025 event, organizers announced on March 16, 2025, that the 2026 festival will be shortened to seven days, running from March 12-18, 2026. This change will see the Conference, Film & TV Festival, and Music Festival all run concurrently. The festival brings together a global audience of artists, industry professionals, and creatives for showcases, film screenings, conference sessions, and networking opportunities. <5> The Shaky Knees Music Festival has officially announced significant changes for its 2025 event, moving to a new venue and time of year. The festival will take place at Piedmont Park in Atlanta from September 19-21, 2025, shifting from its previous location at Central Park and its traditional spring schedule. The 2025 lineup features headliners Deftones (Friday), My Chemical Romance (Saturday), and Blink-182 (Sunday). The extensive lineup also includes a variety of other notable acts such as Vampire Weekend, the return of Alabama Shakes, Lenny Kravitz, Sublime, Cage The Elephant, The Black Keys, Pixies, Public Enemy, Lucy Dacus, and "Weird Al" Yankovic. This move positions the rock-focused festival in the traditional location and fall timeframe previously occupied by the Music Midtown festival, which went on hiatus. <6> Organizers announced that the GoldenSky Country Music Festival in Sacramento will take a hiatus in 2025 with plans to return in 2026. The decision to pause the event, which began in 2022, was made to come back 'bigger and better' and to deliver the best possible festival experience for attendees. Reasons cited for the break include an oversaturation of country music festivals in 2025, making it more challenging to secure top-tier talent. Produced by Danny Wimmer Presents in partnership with Visit Sacramento, the festival saw significant growth, expanding to three days and attracting approximately 75,000 fans in its most recent year, generating a significant economic impact for the region. The organizers have assured fans that this is a 'short break' and not a permanent farewell, with the goal of building a festival that can stand the test of time. <7> South by Southwest (SXSW) is a major annual event in Austin, Texas, that brings together the music, film, television, and creative industries. The event features a wide range of activities including conferences with panels and workshops, exhibitions, live music performances from over 2,000 acts, film and TV screenings, and a comedy festival. [1, 2] A key component is SXSW Interactive, which includes presentations from speakers, panel discussions, and the SXSW Accelerator pitch competition. The 2025 edition of SXSW is scheduled to take place from March 7th to March 15th, 2025, across various venues in Austin. [1, 2] <8> The Life is Beautiful Festival, a major multi-day music and arts event in downtown Las Vegas, is confirmed to be canceled for 2025. First established in 2013 by former Zappos CEO Tony Hsieh, the festival was acquired by Rolling Stone in February 2022. The cancellation follows a significantly downsized 2024 event, rebranded as the 'Big Beautiful Block Party,' which saw a dramatic drop in attendance. The original festival's success was heavily tied to Hsieh's ownership of the downtown real estate that comprised its 18-block footprint; since his death, his estate has sold off many of these properties, making the necessary logistical cooperation for the urban event in its original form impossible. Rolling Stone's official statement cited a need to 'hit pause' and 're-imagine and evolve the festival experience'. The parent company, Penske Media Corporation, has indicated it is searching for downtown real estate to host future festivals, stating that it views the event as a 'long-term investment' and has aspirations to bring a larger version back. <9> The Rock Boat XXV, the 25th-anniversary edition of the floating music festival hosted by Sister Hazel, will take place from January 29 to February 5, 2026. [3, 4, 5] The seven-day cruise sails from Miami, Florida, aboard the Norwegian Pearl to two new destinations for the event: St. Maarten and San Juan, Puerto Rico. [4, 6] The lineup features headliners such as Needtobreathe, Judah & the Lion, The Struts, Matt Nathanson, and Bowling For Soup. [5, 12] Other performers include Red Wanting Blue, Stephen Kellogg and The Twenty-Twenty-Sixers, Carbon Leaf, and The Alternate Routes, with more to be announced. [12] Walk The Moon, The Verve Pipe, American Authors, and The Strumbellas were performers on The Rock Boat XXIV in 2025, not the upcoming XXV. [8, 10, 11] <10> Movement, an annual electronic music festival, is set to take place in Detroit's Hart Plaza over Memorial Day weekend, from May 24-26, 2025. The event celebrates Detroit's significant legacy as the birthplace of techno music. The 2025 edition, announced on February 5, 2025, will feature a lineup of over 115 artists. Confirmed headliners include Belgian techno sensation Charlotte de Witte and dance music superstar John Summit, who join the previously announced Carl Cox. In a tribute to the city's roots, the festival will also feature performances from Detroit icons such as Carl Craig b2b Moodymann with Underground Resistance co-founder Mike Banks.

metadata.original_text: This time series records music festivals data in the web search domain, with a collection frequency of weekly, focusing on monitoring and analyzing relevant indicators. Prediction target period: from 2025-09-28 to 2025-12-14. Recent related events (events are separated by numbered tags): <1> A report titled "Rhythms of Growth: The Economic and Cultural Impact of Music Festivals" was published on September 15, 2025, analyzing how these events serve as significant economic drivers for local communities. The report highlights several key impacts, including substantial job creation, noting that a large festival like Coachella generated over 10,000 jobs in 2024. It also points to the boost provided to local small businesses, such as artisans and food trucks, who benefit from visitors with disposable income. Furthermore, the study indicates that festivals prompt long-term infrastructure investments in host cities, including the development of hotels and transportation, which support the local economy beyond the event's duration. The report concludes that festivals are not just entertainment but also economic powerhouses that foster lasting social connections. <2> The 20th annual Fall Joshua Tree Music Festival is confirmed to take place from October 9-12, 2025, at the Joshua Tree Lake RV & Campground. This anniversary event will continue its tradition of presenting an eclectic and diverse lineup of artists in a unique desert setting. Known for being a family-friendly affair, the festival will feature a world-class curation of music, art, yoga, dance, food, vendors, and workshops. <3> A sustainability impact report for the Outside Festival, which occurred on May 31 and June 1, 2025, was released in partnership with Green Disco. The report, published on August 27, 2025, highlighted a triple-reduced carbon footprint, a 36% waste diversion rate, and the avoidance of over 196,000 single-use plastic bottles. This data demonstrated the successful scalability of sustainable practices, even with an increase in attendance for the event. <4> Tahoe Live, an electronic music festival held at a ski resort, has expanded to a three-day event and is scheduled to take place at Palisades Tahoe, California, from December 12 to December 14, 2025. The festival will feature a lineup of world-class artists, including headliners such as Zeds Dead, Porter Robinson, LSZEE, DJ Diesel (Shaquille O'Neal), and Alison Wonderland, offering attendees a unique blend of daytime skiing and nighttime music. <5> Austin's Levitation festival officially announced its 2025 lineup on May 29, 2025. The four-day event is scheduled to take place from September 25 to September 28, 2025. A significant change for this year is the festival's new central hub at the Palmer Events Center, which will host main stage performances, while additional night shows will still occur at various venues in the Downtown Red River district. The lineup features headliners Pavement, TV On The Radio, and Built To Spill, along with other notable acts such as Mastodon, Acid Bath, The Brian Jonestown Massacre, Unknown Mortal Orchestra, and The Black Angels. <6> The 52nd Bumbershoot Arts & Music Festival announced its lineup on May 7, 2025, for its return to the Seattle Center. The festival will take place over Labor Day weekend, on Saturday, August 30, and Sunday, August 31, 2025. The lineup features headliners such as Weezer, Janelle Monáe, Bright Eyes, and Car Seat Headrest. Other notable performers include Aurora, Sylvan Esso, and Digable Planets. In addition to music, the festival will feature a wide range of other arts, including visual arts installations, performing arts, and culinary arts. <7> A report concerning the 2025 festival season highlights growing safety concerns at major events like Coachella, Lollapalooza, and Rolling Loud, citing an increase in substance-related incidents and calls for emergency services. The analysis emphasizes the importance of attendees being aware of environmental risks such as dehydration from sun exposure. Key prevention strategies are outlined for festival-goers, including the recommendation to study the festival map to identify the locations of medical tents, first-aid stations, and water refill stations. Additionally, attendees are strongly encouraged to use a buddy system and establish a designated, clearly visible meeting point in advance to ensure they can reunite if separated, as cellular networks can be unreliable in large crowds. <8> Riot Fest, a multi-day music festival in Chicago, announced the lineup for its 20th-anniversary event, scheduled to take place from September 19 to September 21, 2025, at Douglass Park. The festival will be headlined by Blink-182 on Friday, Weezer and Jack White on Saturday, and Green Day on Sunday. The full lineup, featuring over 90 bands, was revealed on April 23, 2025. Other notable performers include "Weird Al" Yankovic, The Sex Pistols, Idles, Alkaline Trio, Rilo Kiley, All Time Low, The Beach Boys, Jawbreaker, Dropkick Murphys, and Bad Religion. Several bands will also perform iconic albums in their entirety, such as Weezer playing "The Blue Album". The daily schedule of performances was later released on June 12, 2025. <9> The 2025 Newport Jazz Festival, a long-running event in Newport, Rhode Island, announced its lineup on April 15, 2025. The festival is scheduled to take place from August 1st through August 3rd, 2025, at Fort Adams State Park. The announced lineup features headliners Janelle Monáe, The Roots, and Jacob Collier, among other performers. <10> The 12th annual Suwannee Hulaween festival will take place from Thursday, October 30, to Sunday, November 2, 2025, at the Spirit of the Suwannee Music Park in Live Oak, Florida. The lineup for the multi-genre Halloween weekend event was announced, featuring headliners such as The String Cheese Incident, Goose, Joe Russo's Almost Dead, The Disco Biscuits, Illenium, Zeds Dead, Glass Beams, Parcels, and DJ Pee.Wee (Anderson .Paak). The extensive lineup also includes acts like Franc Moody, Sammy Virji, Molly Tuttle, Pigeons Playing Ping Pong, and the collaborative project LSZEE. The festival is known for its immersive art installations, particularly around Spirit Lake, and will see the return of the underground dance music stage, OFF LIMITS.

Recent related events (events are separated by numbered tags): <1> The 32nd Annual Eagles & Ivories Ragtime Music Festival is scheduled to take place across five locations in Muscatine, Iowa, from January 15 to January 18, 2026. The event will feature live music lineups of world-class ragtime, jazz, and classical artists, as well as silent film comedies with live accompaniment. <2> The Light of Day Foundation announced WinterFest 2026, an annual multi-venue music festival taking place from January 4 to January 24, 2026, aimed at raising funds and awareness for Parkinson's disease, ALS, and PSP. The festival spans several locations across New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania. Its main event, 'Bob's Birthday Bash,' is scheduled for January 17, 2026, at the Count Basie Center for the Arts in Red Bank, New Jersey. <3> The 37th Annual West Coast Ragtime Festival is scheduled to take place from November 21-23, 2025, in Rancho Cordova, California. The weekend-long event is dedicated to celebrating ragtime music and will feature performances by dozens of acclaimed artists and ensembles, including the Pacific Coast Ragtime Orchestra. <4> The Autumn Exit Zero Jazz Festival took place in Cape May, New Jersey, on November 7, 2025. The event showcased international touring artists and featured various styles spanning traditional jazz, blues, folk, and contemporary interpretations. Performances were held across outdoor stages, the Cape May Convention Hall, and numerous local club venues, bars, and restaurants. <5> A market analysis report on the music festival industry was published, providing updated growth projections. The global music festival market is now projected to expand from USD 4.61 billion in 2025 to USD 37.12 billion by 2035, reflecting a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 23.17% over the forecast period. Key trends identified in the report include a significant shift towards sustainability and the emergence of hybrid and virtual events. This focus on eco-friendly practices is a defining trend, with 48% of global festivals implementing measures such as banning single-use plastics, promoting recycling, reducing waste, and improving energy efficiency. <6> A report titled "Rhythms of Growth: The Economic and Cultural Impact of Music Festivals" was published on September 15, 2025, analyzing how these events serve as significant economic drivers for local communities. The report highlights several key impacts, including substantial job creation, noting that a large festival like Coachella generated over 10,000 jobs in 2024. It also points to the boost provided to local small businesses, such as artisans and food trucks, who benefit from visitors with disposable income. Furthermore, the study indicates that festivals prompt long-term infrastructure investments in host cities, including the development of hotels and transportation, which support the local economy beyond the event's duration. The report concludes that festivals are not just entertainment but also economic powerhouses that foster lasting social connections. <7> The 20th annual Fall Joshua Tree Music Festival is confirmed to take place from October 9-12, 2025, at the Joshua Tree Lake RV & Campground. This anniversary event will continue its tradition of presenting an eclectic and diverse lineup of artists in a unique desert setting. Known for being a family-friendly affair, the festival will feature a world-class curation of music, art, yoga, dance, food, vendors, and workshops. <8> The Field & Stream Music Festival, scheduled for October 3-5 in Winnsboro, South Carolina, has been canceled for the second consecutive year. The cancellation was announced on August 27, 2025, with organizers citing "circumstances beyond our control." However, reports suggest that low ticket sales were the actual reason for the cancellation. The 2025 festival lineup was set to feature major headliners including Eric Church, Miranda Lambert, Lynyrd Skynyrd, Riley Green, Bailey Zimmerman, and ZZ Top. The inaugural festival in 2024 was also canceled due to Hurricane Helene. The festival was part of a larger effort by country music stars Eric Church and Morgan Wallen to revitalize the Field & Stream brand, which they had purchased in January 2024. <9> A sustainability impact report for the Outside Festival, which occurred on May 31 and June 1, 2025, was released in partnership with Green Disco. The report, published on August 27, 2025, highlighted a triple-reduced carbon footprint, a 36% waste diversion rate, and the avoidance of over 196,000 single-use plastic bottles. This data demonstrated the successful scalability of sustainable practices, even with an increase in attendance for the event.
